data.narrative: Completed Module 8 'Integration & Verification' learning about bringing parallel workstreams together, contract comparison to catch mismatches before merging, incremental integration to isolate failures, end-to-end scenario testing, requirements traceability, and diagnosing integration bugs that live in component seams.

dimension_scores.observation: Extracted integration bug symptom and traced through components: booking service creates status='confirmed', dashboard filters for status='active', contract mismatch between components
dimension_scores.evidence: module8_break.md documents debugging process identifying status enum mismatch

dimension_scores.observation: Chose incremental integration order: auth/database first (most contract touchpoints), provider/listing second, booking/delegation third. Merge order designed to validate most interfaces early
dimension_scores.evidence: module-08-merge-plan.md defines 3-stream merge order with rationale for each sequence

dimension_scores.observation: Identified missing notification service contract as potential integration gap. Proposed systemic fixes: shared enums, contract testing, integration test suite, shared type definitions to prevent contract mismatches
dimension_scores.evidence: module-08-contract-comparison.md identifies missing notification contract, module8_fix.md proposes 5 systemic prevention strategies

dimension_scores.observation: Created detailed integration test plan with 5 cross-component tests specifying components, setup, steps, expected results, and contract points validated for each test
dimension_scores.evidence: module-08-integration-test-plan.md includes 5 tests with complete specifications

dimension_scores.observation: Adapted plan twice during Module 7 (company accounts, role-based access) while maintaining coherence. Module 8 integration validated those adaptations through contract comparison and scenario testing
dimension_scores.evidence: module-08-contract-comparison.md confirmed no mismatches between Module 6 and 7 contracts

dimension_scores.observation: Diagnosed integration bug by tracing through component boundaries: booking service output (status='confirmed') vs dashboard input (status='active'). Identified as contract mismatch in the seam, not component bug
dimension_scores.evidence: module8_break.md walks through debugging process identifying status enum contract mismatch

strengths: Chose incremental integration over big bang for failure isolation
Created comprehensive integration artifacts (5 phases: contract comparison, merge plan, scenarios, traceability, test plan)
Diagnosed integration bug by tracing component handoffs and data formats
Proposed systemic fixes (shared enums, contract testing) to prevent future contract mismatches
data.recommendation: Use integration skills in real projects - maintain interface contracts, run contract tests on every merge, implement requirements traceability to catch lost requirements early

public_evidence.artifact: 5 integration artifacts for parallel workstream integration
public_evidence.student_action: Created comprehensive integration plan: contract comparison (no mismatches between Module 6/7, identified missing notification contract), incremental merge plan (3 streams with acceptance criteria and smoke tests), 4 end-to-end scenarios (happy path, delegation, department scope, concurrent booking), requirements traceability matrix (6 built, 8 deferred, 0 lost), integration test plan (5 cross-component tests). Diagnosed status enum mismatch bug and proposed systemic fixes.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Merge order: auth/database (JWT structure, user data model), provider/listing (provider data model), booking/delegation (role-based middleware). Scenarios test: employee booking, manager delegation, department head limitation, concurrent booking. Tests validate: booking propagation, RBAC, department scope, datetime format (ISO 8601), UUID format.
public_evidence.ability: Integration and verification of parallel workstreams
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to bring parallel workstreams together, identify and fix integration bugs, maintain requirements traceability, and implement systemic fixes to prevent future integration failures

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Chose incremental over big bang integration to isolate failures to specific merges
Traced booking service status='confirmed' vs dashboard filter status='active' as contract mismatch in component seam
Created matrix mapping all Module 1 requirements to Built/Simplified/Deferred/Lost status with specific locations
